note: Field photographs shown in "From the field" on the home page. Captions come from here; order is the display order.

photos.alt: Black-and-white photograph of the open-pit mercury mine, its terraced benches descending to the pit floor
photos.caption: Historical view of the open-pit mercury mine and its terraced benches.

photos.alt: A pit lake with an orange, iron-stained shoreline under a clear sky
photos.caption: The mine's pit lake — iron-stained shoreline and pale mineral crust along the water's edge.

photos.alt: A gloved hand holding a handheld XRF analyzer against a rock
photos.caption: Taking a handheld XRF reading directly on exposed rock.

photos.alt: A bright red rock among grey stones and leaf litter
photos.caption: A cinnabar-red rock among the mine waste.

photos.alt: A gloved hand holding a sealed glass sample jar of soil
photos.caption: A soil sample collected and sealed in a labeled jar.

photos.alt: A drill bit working into a rock beside a plastic sample bag
photos.caption: Drilling a rock chip to collect a sample in the field.

photos.alt: A yellow excavator among large boulders and scrub oak
photos.caption: An excavator working among boulders.

photos.alt: Pink and red crystals scattered across a white rock surface
photos.caption: Red mineral crystals on a pale rock face.

photos.alt: A handheld XRF analyzer and batteries in a foam-lined case
photos.caption: A handheld XRF analyzer in its field case.

photos.alt: An excavator cutting a slope while a hose sprays water to control dust
photos.caption: Excavation with a water spray to keep the dust down.

photos.alt: An orange excavator working behind a roped exclusion-zone sign, a worker spraying water, and excavated rock on white plastic sheeting
photos.caption: Excavation behind the exclusion zone, with a water spray for dust and excavated material laid out on plastic sheeting.

photos.alt: A blue-gloved hand holding three pieces of bright red rock above an excavation
photos.caption: Cinnabar-red rock from the excavation, in a gloved hand.

photos.alt: Pale yellow and rust-stained ground sloping down to a green pit lake under a blue sky
photos.caption: Altered, mineral-stained ground running down to the pit lake.

photos.alt: A trench wall of roots and dark soil over weathered rock, with pale yellowish material at the base
photos.caption: A trench wall: roots and dark soil over weathered rock, with pale, altered material at the base.

photos.alt: A wide green pit lake with pale terraced mine benches along its far shore and oak-covered hills
photos.caption: The pit lake, with the mine's terraced benches along the far shore.

photos.alt: An excavator bucket digging into a slope while a person in white coveralls sprays water
photos.caption: An excavator digs while a crew member in protective coveralls sprays water to keep the dust down.

photos.alt: A tall white drill rig on a landfill slope above a wide valley
photos.caption: Drilling on the upper slope, with the valley spread out below.

photos.alt: A large black roll of textured geomembrane unrolling across a slope, a worker and telehandler behind
photos.caption: Unrolling textured geomembrane across the prepared slope.

photos.alt: A yellow Demtech Pro-Tester tensiometer with its clamps open, on textured geomembrane
photos.caption: A field tensiometer for seam samples: each weld is pulled apart to check its strength.

photos.alt: A wide landfill cell seen from its rim, black and white liner layers across the floor under a clear sky
photos.caption: The new cell from its rim: liner going down across the floor, the existing landfill beyond.

photos.alt: A track loader spreading grey drain rock over black liner while two workers stand at a pipe trench
photos.caption: Placing drain rock around the leachate collection pipe.

photos.alt: The sun setting over rippled black geomembrane on a landfill cell floor
photos.caption: Sunset over newly deployed geomembrane, its wrinkles catching the light.
